rationale: Immutable dead-letter replay already preserves EventId and the complete logical Envelope.
A completed consumer Inbox must remain authoritative for idempotency.
Re-running an accepted business effect needs separate product semantics and downstream side-effect controls that are outside this milestone.
supportedOperations: authorized dry-run of an immutable dead-letter replay
authorized audited replay of the original EventId and Envelope
prohibitedOperations: force a completed Inbox item through the business handler again
mint a replacement EventId to evade Inbox deduplication
modify or delete an Inbox marker to force execution
mutate original logical bytes during replay
direct operator DML against messaging tables

approval.authority: repository owner direction to execute P02-C3 after the no-forced-reprocessing recommendation
